name: Proton Mail web (read-only search and conversation read)

findAccountSlot.description: Which Proton account slot (/u/<n>/) owns an email address. Navigates /u/<n>/inbox for n=0..maxSlots-1 in its own background tab, waits for the title to carry an address, and matches document.title. Proton redirects an unknown slot to a signed-in one, so the slot is read from the final URL, not the loop index.

searchRows.description: Open /u/<slot>/almost-all-mail#keyword=<term> in a background tab, poll until the result rows stop changing, and read them with textContent (innerText is empty for rows after the first in a background tab). Read-only.

returns.description: {rows:[{index, id (data-element-id, the conversation id), text (whitespace-collapsed, 200 chars)}]}; {rows:[], hint} when nothing appears within 15s

readConversation.description: Search, real-click result row <index> (focus emulation lets a background tab open it without bringToFront), expand every collapsed message by clicking its header, and read each iframe[data-testid=content-iframe] body as plain text. Opening a message can mark an unread one as read (Proton default). Never sends, deletes, moves or labels. Pass url (a full /<label>/<conversationId>/<messageId> link from a previous result) instead of term to skip the search.

term.description: keyword search term; exactly one of term or url

index.description: which result row to open, default 0

url.description: a https://mail.proton.me/... conversation/message URL; exactly one of term or url

maxChars.description: per-message text truncation, default 1600; chars always reports the full length

maxMessages.description: expand at most this many collapsed messages, default 30

returns.description: {url, total, read, errorBanner, messages:[{index, expanded, header, chars, text}]}; {stop:"no-results"|"index-out-of-range"|"conversation-not-loaded", hint}
